plain: In OpenAI's Model Spec, the company or person building an app on the API, who writes the developer message.
eli5: The person who built the game and wrote its rules before you started playing.
technical: One of the Model Spec's message roles and authority levels: developer messages outrank user messages but sit below Root and System, and the role corresponds to the constitution's operator; in Wallace et al. (2024) the developer's instructions arrive as the system message, which is why "system" names a different party in the two documents (see system prompt).
